author: claude
D1: RESOLVED = {answered, dropped} is the only closing set. Top = lowest rank among every other status (open, active, unknown). A question absent from the file or with an unknown status keeps its incident. Unreadable priorities open an UNKNOWN gap whose clock and delivery carry over to the real top question when the file is readable again. Tests: test_active_top_question_is_tracked, test_open_to_active_keeps_incident, test_unknown_or_absent_status_does_not_close, test_dropped_closes, test_unreadable_priorities_gap_carries_to_top.
D2: EXECUTING_STEPS = {worker, verify} (the seat-working steps of the installed agent-loop status). held, blocked, unknown, decision, handoff, empty, timed-out, closed do not suppress the gap; no handoff step invented. A legitimate decision wait uses a timed REST.jsonl row; P13 decision ownership unchanged. Tests: test_non_executing_steps_open_the_gap (6 subtests), test_bound_executing_package_is_quiet (worker, verify) replaces the old decision-is-quiet case.
